_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: users
constraints: CHECK (gender IN ('male', 'female', 'other') OR gender IS NULL)
CHECK (dietary_preference IN ('omnivore', 'vegetarian', 'pescatarian', 'vegan', 'mediterranean', 'paleo', 'keto', 'low_carb') OR dietary_preference IS NULL)
CHECK (sweat_sodium IN ('low', 'average', 'high') OR sweat_sodium IS NULL)
CHECK (sweat_test_source IN ('self_calculated', 'commercial_test', 'gatorade_gx', 'estimated', 'other') OR sweat_test_source IS NULL)

data.name: events
constraints: CHECK (carb_loading_days IS NULL OR carb_loading_days IN (1, 2, 3, 7))

data.name: carb_loading_plans
constraints: CHECK (adherence_score IS NULL OR (adherence_score >= 0.0 AND adherence_score <= 1.0))

data.name: carb_loading_day_meals
constraints: CHECK ((carb_loading_food_id IS NOT NULL AND carb_loading_user_food_id IS NULL) OR (carb_loading_food_id IS NULL AND carb_loading_user_food_id IS NOT NULL))

data.name: integrations
constraints: CHECK (last_sync_status IS NULL OR last_sync_status IN ('success', 'error', 'pending', 'requires_reauth'))
